1 January 2027 · Vanderbilt: second early decision and regular decision.

For fall 2027, ED II and Regular Decision are on the same day. The first early decision (ED I) was 1 November 2026. SAT/ACT is optional.

Imperial has two English levels

2026/27: Standard level is IELTS 6.5 (6.0 in each section) or TOEFL 92 / new scale 4.5. Higher level is IELTS 7.0 (6.5) or TOEFL 100 / 5.0. Which level applies depends on the program. Check your program's page.

Source: imperial.ac.uk (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

A year's tuition bill in the USA (2026-27)

Carnegie Mellon: $69,702 (private; tuition only, fees separate)
UC Irvine: $59,375 (out-of-state, fall 2026 entry, with insurance)
UCLA: $55,700 (out-of-state, total with surcharge and fees)
Maryland College Park: $44,086 (out-of-state, tuition and fees)

The out-of-state rate also applies to international students. Housing and books are not included. Insurance is included only at Irvine.

Source: cmu.edu, reg.uci.edu, admission.ucla.edu, usmd.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
